refnamediv.refpurpose: Returns the value generated for an AUTO_INCREMENT column by the last statement executed

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.returnvalues;
The value of the AUTO_INCREMENT field that was updated by the statement. Returns zero if the statement has not been executed yet or if it did not update an AUTO_INCREMENT value.
The value is specific to the statement object. It is not affected by other statements executed on the same connection after this statement, nor by statements issued using other connections or clients.
If the number is greater than the maximum int value, it will be returned as a string.
